title: End-to-End Live Supabase Persistence, Restart, Trigger & Monorepo Regression Verification
description: Execute full live verification against Supabase PostgreSQL (boot log, /health store=postgresql, seeded d_8821_juki fetch, state mutation + voucher minting across process restart, trg_vouchers_append_only UPDATE/DELETE rejection, and dual-mode fallback when DATABASE_URL is unreachable/empty) plus full monorepo test/typecheck/lint/build gates.
acceptance_criteria: Live deal-engine-go boots with store='postgresql' on /health and serves seeded d_8821_juki
Mutated deal state and signed Ed25519 voucher chain persist across deal-engine-go process restart
PostgreSQL trigger trg_vouchers_append_only rejects UPDATE and DELETE on system_audit_vouchers with 'system_audit_vouchers is append-only'
Dual-mode fallback verified with empty/unreachable DATABASE_URL returning store='in-memory'
go test -v -race ./..., pnpm typecheck, pnpm test, pnpm build, and cargo test pass with zero errors and no lingering background processes
